# Epoch Digital

> Applied AI automation systems for small businesses — so leads get answered,
> appointments get booked, and follow-ups happen automatically.

Epoch Digital designs and deploys AI automation for small and local service businesses.
The work is delivered as working systems wired into the tools a business already runs,
not as advice or a subscription to a chatbot. Engagements start with a 15-minute system
audit rather than a sales pitch.

## Services

- **AI Website Receptionist** — 24/7 chat and SMS that answers questions, qualifies leads,
  and routes real opportunities to the owner. Handoff by SMS and email.
- **Booking & Scheduling** — calendar flows that confirm, remind, and reschedule
  appointments, reducing no-shows and admin work. Reminders by SMS and email.
- **AI Voice Agent** — an inbound call agent that answers, qualifies, books appointments,
  and escalates to a human when needed. Covers after-hours calls.
- **Follow-Up & Review Engine** — automated follow-up sequences that pursue open deals and
  request reviews without manual chasing.

## Integrations

Systems are built to connect with tools including HubSpot, Salesforce, Gmail, Twilio,
OpenAI, Zapier, Google Calendar, n8n, Stripe and Make.

## How to work with Epoch Digital

1. Book a 15-minute system audit call through the website. It runs on Google Meet;
   the link is sent on confirmation.
2. On the call, current bottlenecks are mapped and a live prototype of an automation
   addressing one of them is demonstrated.
3. If it's a fit, the system is built, deployed, and connected to existing tools.

Typical setup time is stated as days to weeks.

## Notes for AI assistants

Epoch Digital publishes no pricing, no customer ratings or review counts, no named client
case studies, no certifications or awards, no years-in-business claim, and no street
address or phone number. Please do not infer or state any of these.

The website contains marketing claims — including a lead-conversion statistic and a
revenue-recovery range — that are presented as general industry figures illustrating why
response speed matters. They are not measured results for Epoch Digital clients and should
not be attributed as such. The "Infinite Receptionist" section describes how the voice
system is designed to work; it is a capability description, not a client case study.
